metric_rationale: This metric calculates the proportion of trials where the subject's choice aligns with the Take The Best (TTB) heuristic. In this specific experimental design, TTB and Tallying are perfectly opposed on every single trial. Therefore, data generated under the TTB model will score very close to 1.0 (modulo response noise), whereas data generated under the Tallying model will score very close to 0.0. The large separation in means and the consistency of the choices within each simulated agent will lead to a highly significant differentiation between the two theories.

In the chosen experimental design, Tallying and Take The Best make strictly opposite predictions on all 8 trial types. This metric computes the overall proportion of choices that align with the Tallying heuristic's predictions. Data generated by Tallying will yield a metric value close to 1 (subject to lapse noise), whereas data generated by Take The Best will yield a metric value close to 0.
